Edge Wallet is a non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet. Edge Wallet keeps users' private keys under their own control rather than with a third party. Edge Wallet supports multiple cryptocurrencies within one application.

Trezor Safe 3 is a hardware wallet that stores private keys offline on a dedicated device. Trezor Safe 3 includes a secure element for key protection. Trezor Safe 3 connects to a computer or mobile device to sign blockchain transactions.

Argent is a non-custodial smart contract wallet on the Ethereum blockchain. Argent operates as a mobile application for users. Argent supports account recovery through trusted contacts called guardians.

Town Crier is an oracle system that delivers authenticated web data to smart contracts. Town Crier relies on trusted hardware (Intel SGX) to attest the data it relays. Town Crier is not a wallet and does not hold user funds.
